name: Selegiline
effects: Selective MAO-B inhibitor at low oral doses (≤10 mg/day) — approved for Parkinson's; also acts as dopamine enhancer via amphetamine metabolites
Transdermal patch (Emsam) approved for MDD — higher doses lose MAO-B selectivity, inhibit MAO-A
At 6 mg/24h patch: no dietary tyramine restriction required; at ≥9 mg/24h: restrictions apply
Metabolized to L-amphetamine and L-methamphetamine (CNS stimulant effect)
Insomnia, application site reactions (patch), orthostatic hypotension
Requires washout before switching to serotonergic drugs
